# Pesher Psalms Column 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** 4QpPs (4Q171), Col. 1 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1:1** [...] "Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; fret not over the one who prospers in his way, over the man who carries out evil devices" (Psalm 37:7).

**1:2** [...] and those who turn back from [...]

**1:3** Its interpretation concerns the Man of the Lie, who led many astray with deceitful words, for they chose worthless things and did not listen

**1:4** to the Interpreter of Knowledge, who [...]

**1:5** [...] they shall perish by sword, by famine, and by plague.

**1:6** "For yet a little while, and the wicked shall be no more; you will look carefully at his place, and he will not be there" (Psalm 37:10).

**1:7** Its interpretation concerns all the wickedness at the end of forty years, when

**1:8** they are consumed, and there will not be found on the earth any wicked man.

**1:9** "But the meek shall inherit the land and shall delight in abundant peace" (Psalm 37:11).

**1:10** Its interpretation concerns the Congregation of the Poor, who accept the time of affliction and shall be delivered

**1:11** from all the snares of Belial. Afterward, they shall delight in all the [...] of

**1:12** the earth, and shall feast on every delicacy of the flesh.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. "Pesher" rendered as "interpretation" (LOGOS), retaining the technical exegetical sense. "Man of the Lie" and "Interpreter of Knowledge" preserved as capitalized titles (EMET/LOGOS). "Belial" retained over PNEUMA's "Devil" — the Qumran term carries distinctive sectarian theology. "Congregation of the Poor" adopted from LOGOS — a recognized community self-designation. Psalm quotations follow the form closest to the MT as preserved in 4Q171.*
